story.title: From scattered signals to decisions that hold.
story.intro: Institutional clarity is rarely built from more data. It comes from interpreting signals across technology, constitution and statecraft, in five moves.

steps.title: Data
steps.body: The world produces more information than any institution can read. We begin with what is openly knowable: law, policy, research, markets and public sources.

steps.title: Intelligence
steps.body: We connect it. Patterns, actors and dependencies emerge when information is read across disciplines rather than within them.
steps.keyTitle: The densest settlements, read as one network

steps.title: Understanding
steps.body: We interpret it through the lenses of law, technology and governance, until the picture is clear enough to act on.
steps.keyTitle: Raw signal, resolved by the lens

steps.title: Strategy
steps.body: We turn understanding into direction: policy positions, governance frameworks, partnerships and programmes with a clear line of sight to outcomes.
steps.keyTitle: Many candidate routes, seven kept, one destination

steps.title: Impact
steps.body: And we stay through delivery, because advice only matters when it changes what happens next.

founders.lede: Priya Lalwani and Varad Ozarkar co-founded OMAV Global Ventures Pvt. Ltd. to bring strategy, technology and governance to the institutions shaping what comes next.

people.name: Priya Lalwani
bio: Priya Lalwani is a co-founder of OMAV Global Ventures Pvt. Ltd., where she leads the firm’s strategy, operations and public-sector transformation work. She holds an MBA in Corporate Strategy and Operations from Columbia Business School.

Priya has led multi-million-dollar modernisation programmes for US state governments, directing cross-functional teams of more than sixty professionals across two continents. Her coordination of a twenty-four-hour response to a state-level security incident was recognised with the GovTech Innovation Award.

Previously, as Chief Strategy Officer and a founding executive of an education venture serving Europe, the Middle East, Africa and the United States, she more than doubled revenue and introduced AI-enabled analytics and matching that improved student retention by a quarter. At Columbia, she served as Vice President of the South Asian Business Association.

people.name: Varad Ozarkar
people.focus: AI governance · Cyber policy · International strategy
bio: Varad Ozarkar is a co-founder of OMAV Global Ventures Pvt. Ltd., where he leads the firm’s work on AI governance and international strategy. His platforms are in use across the Maharashtra state administration.

Varad conceived and deployed Maharashtra’s first AI-based public-sector recruitment system, designed for transparency and constitutional bias controls, and built the state’s cyber-safety platforms, including an AI-powered cyber-crime call agent and the Maharashtra Cyber Safe app. The work was felicitated by the Hon’ble Chief Minister of Maharashtra and honoured at the Bombay Stock Exchange during DSCI and NASSCOM’s “Ring the Bell for Security & Privacy.”

He advises state law-enforcement leadership on AI and cyber strategy, and helped shape the New Jersey–India Mission on Investment and Strategy with the office of Governor Phil Murphy. He was invited to the Harvard India Conference in 2025.
